research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Meta View is engaged in developing an augmented reality collaboration system with annotation capability, as described in a system comprising a user device configured to display virtual content using one or more displays, hardware processors, and machine-readable storage. This research and development focuses on enabling collaborative interactions and annotations within augmented reality environments, highlighting Meta View’s work in AR solutions for business applications.

overview_description.description:
Meta View is an electronic company that provides augmented and virtual reality solutions for various businesses in the United States. It offers wearable devices that provide augmented and virtual reality experience and other gadgets based on machine learning and artificial intelligence. 

Ben Sand, Meron Gribetz, and Raymond Lo founded Meta View in 2019. It has its headquarters in San Mateo in California.
